criteria.name: states-complexity
criteria.anchor: 1.0: gives the correct complexity and what dominates. 0.5: right idea, no complexity. 0.0: wrong.

criteria.name: single-pass-fix
criteria.anchor: 1.0: a correct single-pass streaming rewrite. 0.5: right idea, incomplete or buggy code. 0.0: no fix.

expected_outcomes: Identifies that the whole log file is read and split once per agent, so total work is O(agents x log size), about 5,000 x 40 MB of IO and parsing
Notes JSON unmarshal is attempted for every line for every agent, multiplying the cost
Proposes a single pass: read the log once (streaming with bufio.Scanner or Decoder), unmarshal each line once, and accumulate into the map, filtering by a set of wanted agents if needed
Notes streaming also avoids holding 40 MB plus its string copy in memory
